title: Emphasize Selected Gray Text Color
description: When selecting text (e.g. such as the description of a step in the introduction) then make sure that the selected text is emphasized color because the gray text is not readable with active filling.
summary: Selected text now uses the emphasized (foreground) color on the accent selection fill, so muted gray copy such as introduction step descriptions stays readable. Updated ::selection / ::-moz-selection in ui.css and covered it in the styling index test.
